name: Risen Cake
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: one and a half pounds of pounded sugar
ingredients.originalText: one and a half pounds of pounded sugar

instructions.text: Take three pounds of flour, one and a half pounds of pounded sugar, a tea-spoonful of cloves, one of mace, and one of ginger, all finely powdered
Pass the whole through a sieve
Put to it four spoonsful of good yeast, and twelve eggs
Mix it up well, and if not sufficiently soft, add a little milk
Make it up at night, and set it to rise
When well risen, knead into it a pound of butter, and two gills of brandy
Have ready two pounds of raisins stoned
Pour it into a mould of proper size
Bake it in an oven heated as for bread
Let it stand till thoroughly done
Do not take it from the mould until quite cold

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take three pounds of flour, one and a half pounds of pounded sugar, a tea-spoonful of cloves, one of mace, and one of ginger, all finely powdered
2. Pass the whole through a sieve
3. Put to it four spoonsful of good yeast, and twelve eggs
4. Mix it up well, and if not sufficiently soft, add a little milk
5. Make it up at night, and set it to rise
6. When well risen, knead into it a pound of butter, and two gills of brandy
7. Have ready two pounds of raisins stoned
8. Mix all well together
9. Pour it into a mould of proper size
10. Bake it in an oven heated as for bread
11. Let it stand till thoroughly done
12. Do not take it from the mould until quite cold
